# @thewaver/ss-components

> SolidJS components for building shaped UI. Headless: structure, behavior and ARIA wiring only —
> no color, spacing or typography. The consumer supplies all visual styling.

Peer dependencies: `@thewaver/ss-utils`, `solid-js`. CSS entry point: `@thewaver/ss-components/styles.css`
(structural only, required). Full prop tables and interactive examples: https://ss-components.vercel.app

Authoritative signatures, prop types and prop-level doc comments are in `dist/index.d.ts` inside the
published package — read that for ground truth on any single component rather than this file.

## Components

Grouped by the source tree's own top-level folders.

### Essentials — the standard control and layout set
Accordion, Collapsible, AudioSwitcher, Breadcrumbs, Button, Calendar, RangeCalendar, Checkbox,
CheckboxGroup, Clock, ColorArea, ColorInput, CurrencyInput, DateInput, DatePicker, DateRangePicker,
DateTimePicker, DrumCarousel, TrackCarousel, Drawer, HoverCard, FanMenu, FileInput, Form, FormField,
FormSection, ImageSwitcher, Label, Listbox, MultiListbox, Menu, Menubar, Modal, MultiSelect, NumberInput, Paginator, Preview,
Progress, Radio, RadioGroup, Range, Scroller, Select, SlideButton, Sortable, SpotlightGuide,
SpotlightHint, SpotlightPrompt, SplitPane, Stepper, Table, Tabs, TagInput, TextArea, TextInput,
TimeInput, TimePicker, Toasts, Toggle, Toolbar, Tooltip, Tree, ViewportWrapper, WheelMenu.

### Exotics — visual and motion effects
Bracket, CellAnimation, Corners, Cuboid, ElementMosaic, ImageMosaic, FlipCard, Formation,
Odometer, ParticleSpawner, PatchBoard, Reveal, RichText, Satellite, ScanlineAnimation,
ScrambleText, ScratchCard, Shape, SortableGrid, Staircase, TileBoard, Timeline,
Trail, Typewriter, DrumWheel, OverheadWheel.

### Composites — assemblies of the above
GlassSurface, Surface.

### Primitives — lower-level building blocks the above are built from
Barrel, InteractionWrapper, PlacementBox, PlacementItem, Popover.

### Abstracts — Solid-based state/behavior hooks (no markup of their own)
Anchor, Carrier, CheckedState, ColorExtractor, Cutout, Placement, Proximity, DateTimeValue,
DateValue, Dismisser, ElementFader, ElementObserver, Elevation, Flattener, FrameRateMonitor,
FocusManager, Glass, InteractionTracker, LiveAnnouncer, MaskedField, MediaQueryMonitor,
Navigator, PointerTracker, Rotator, SVG defs (animation/filter/gradient/pattern), SignalMirror,
TextSync, Typeahead, Viewport, Virtualizer.

### Samples — sample/registry data for the Exotics above (keyframes, weights, gradients,
patterns, layouts, connectors), meant to be copied or referenced, not a stable API surface.
